xml_structure:
<e-flexbox configuration-id="menu-root-container">
    <e-flexbox configuration-id="banner-resumen">
      <e-flexbox configuration-id="banner-left">
        <e-paragraph configuration-id="banner-calendar-icon"></e-paragraph>
        <e-flexbox configuration-id="banner-titles">
          <e-heading configuration-id="banner-title"></e-heading>
          <e-paragraph configuration-id="banner-subtitle"></e-paragraph>
        </e-flexbox>
      </e-flexbox>
      <e-paragraph configuration-id="banner-badge"></e-paragraph>
    </e-flexbox>

    <e-flexbox configuration-id="card-planificacion">
      <e-paragraph configuration-id="plan-eyebrow"></e-paragraph>
      <e-flexbox configuration-id="plan-header-row">

          <e-heading configuration-id="plan-h1"></e-heading>
          <e-paragraph configuration-id="plan-desc"></e-paragraph>
        </e-flexbox>
        <e-flexbox configuration-id="plan-header-box">
          <e-paragraph configuration-id="box-icon"></e-paragraph>
          <e-flexbox configuration-id="box-texts">
            <e-heading configuration-id="box-title"></e-heading>
            <e-paragraph configuration-id="box-desc"></e-paragraph>
          </e-flexbox>
        </e-flexbox>
      </e-flexbox>
    </e-flexbox>

    <e-flexbox configuration-id="selector-dias">
      <e-button configuration-id="dia-lunes"></e-button>
      <e-button configuration-id="dia-martes"></e-button>
      <e-button configuration-id="dia-miercoles"></e-button>
      <e-button configuration-id="dia-jueves"></e-button>
      <e-button configuration-id="dia-viernes"></e-button>
      <e-button configuration-id="dia-sabado"></e-button>
    </e-flexbox>

    <e-flexbox configuration-id="banner-dia-activo">
      <e-flexbox configuration-id="banner-dia-left">
        <e-flexbox configuration-id="banner-dia-title-row">

        </e-flexbox>
        <e-paragraph configuration-id="dia-activo-subtitle"></e-paragraph>
      </e-flexbox>
      <e-paragraph configuration-id="dia-activo-counter"></e-paragraph>
    </e-flexbox>

    <e-flexbox configuration-id="grilla-platos">
      <e-flexbox configuration-id="card-plato-1">
        <e-image configuration-id="img-plato-1"></e-image>
        <e-flexbox configuration-id="body-plato-1">
          <e-heading configuration-id="title-plato-1"></e-heading>
          <e-paragraph configuration-id="desc-plato-1"></e-paragraph>
          <e-paragraph configuration-id="side-plato-1"></e-paragraph>
          <e-flexbox configuration-id="footer-plato-1">
            <e-heading configuration-id="price-plato-1"></e-heading>
            <e-button configuration-id="btn-plato-1"></e-button>
          </e-flexbox>
        </e-flexbox>
      </e-flexbox>

      <e-flexbox configuration-id="card-plato-2">
        <e-image configuration-id="img-plato-2"></e-image>
        <e-flexbox configuration-id="body-plato-2">
          <e-heading configuration-id="title-plato-2"></e-heading>
          <e-paragraph configuration-id="desc-plato-2"></e-paragraph>
          <e-paragraph configuration-id="side-plato-2"></e-paragraph>
          <e-flexbox configuration-id="footer-plato-2">
            <e-heading configuration-id="price-plato-2"></e-heading>
            <e-button configuration-id="btn-plato-2"></e-button>
          </e-flexbox>
        </e-flexbox>
      </e-flexbox>

      <e-flexbox configuration-id="card-plato-3">
        <e-image configuration-id="img-plato-3"></e-image>
        <e-flexbox configuration-id="body-plato-3">
          <e-heading configuration-id="title-plato-3"></e-heading>
          <e-paragraph configuration-id="desc-plato-3"></e-paragraph>
          <e-paragraph configuration-id="side-plato-3"></e-paragraph>
          <e-flexbox configuration-id="footer-plato-3">
            <e-heading configuration-id="price-plato-3"></e-heading>
            <e-button configuration-id="btn-plato-3"></e-button>
          </e-flexbox>
        </e-flexbox>
      </e-flexbox>
    </e-flexbox>
  </e-flexbox>
<e-flexbox configuration-id="gf-root-footer-wrapper">
<e-flexbox configuration-id="gf-footer-inner-boxed">
<e-flexbox configuration-id="gf-footer-top-columns">
<e-flexbox configuration-id="gf-col-branding">
<e-flexbox configuration-id="gf-col-brand-header">
<e-image configuration-id="gf-col-brand-logo"></e-image>
<e-flexbox configuration-id="gf-col-brand-titles">
<e-paragraph configuration-id="gf-col-brand-badge"></e-paragraph>
<e-paragraph configuration-id="gf-col-brand-tagline"></e-paragraph>
</e-flexbox>
</e-flexbox>
<e-paragraph configuration-id="gf-col-brand-desc"></e-paragraph>
<e-heading configuration-id="gf-col-brand-social-title"></e-heading>
<e-flexbox configuration-id="gf-col-brand-social-row">
<e-paragraph configuration-id="gf-social-ig"></e-paragraph>
<e-paragraph configuration-id="gf-social-wa"></e-paragraph>
<e-paragraph configuration-id="gf-social-fb"></e-paragraph>
<e-paragraph configuration-id="gf-social-li"></e-paragraph>
</e-flexbox>
</e-flexbox>
<e-flexbox configuration-id="gf-col-nav">
<e-heading configuration-id="gf-col-nav-title"></e-heading>
<e-paragraph configuration-id="gf-col-nav-links"></e-paragraph>
</e-flexbox>
<e-flexbox configuration-id="gf-col-empresas">
<e-heading configuration-id="gf-col-empresas-title"></e-heading>
<e-paragraph configuration-id="gf-col-empresas-links"></e-paragraph>
</e-flexbox>
<e-flexbox configuration-id="gf-col-ubicacion">
<e-heading configuration-id="gf-col-ubicacion-title"></e-heading>
<e-paragraph configuration-id="gf-col-ubicacion-links"></e-paragraph>
</e-flexbox>
<e-flexbox configuration-id="gf-col-horarios">
<e-heading configuration-id="gf-col-horarios-title"></e-heading>
<e-paragraph configuration-id="gf-col-horarios-links"></e-paragraph>
</e-flexbox>
</e-flexbox>
<e-flexbox configuration-id="gf-footer-sublegal">
<e-paragraph configuration-id="gf-footer-legal-copy"></e-paragraph>
<e-paragraph configuration-id="gf-footer-legal-terms"></e-paragraph>
</e-flexbox>
</e-flexbox>
</e-flexbox>

banner-subtitle.paragraph: 4 semanas completas de rotación criolla sin repetir platos

banner-badge.paragraph: Catálogo Semanal • Vista Día por Día

plan-eyebrow.paragraph: 📅 PLANIFICA TUS ALMUERZOS DE OFICINA • CERO REPETICIÓN

plan-desc.paragraph: Comida criolla fresca de paila panameña lista para tus almuerzos de oficina. Elige el día, selecciona tus platos ejecutivos y recíbelos calientes a la hora de almuerzo.

dia-activo-subtitle.paragraph: Arranca la semana laboral con energía criolla y guisos reconfortantes de olla honda.

desc-plato-1.paragraph: El rey indiscutible de Panamá: caldo espeso con ñame baboso, gallina suave y abundante culantro.

title-plato-2.title: Mondongo a la Culantro con Papitas

desc-plato-2.paragraph: Mondongo suave y limpio, estofado a fuego lento con salsa criolla de culantro y papas en cubos.

desc-plato-3.paragraph: Presas de pollo marinadas con achiote natural del interior, orégano y salsa densa para el arroz.

gf-col-brand-desc.paragraph: La paila auténtica panameña adaptada al ritmo de oficina. Almuerzos calientes y desayunos criollos empacados en bandejas térmicas troqueladas a 75°C, con factura fiscal y cero filas.

gf-col-nav-links.paragraph: 🏠 Inicio & Resumen📅 Menú Semanal (Lun-Sáb)🎄 Especial Navideño (15 Nov)🔥 Platos del Día🍳 Desayunos (6:30 AM)📜 Carta Completa

gf-col-empresas-links.paragraph: 🏢 Página Empresa & CombosBandejas para Reuniones de OficinaCombos para 5 & 10 PersonasFactura Fiscal con RUC (DGI)Entrega Garantizada a las 12:00 MD

gf-col-ubicacion-links.paragraph: 📍 Dónde Comer & RetirarCalle 50, ObarrioPick & Go Express (10 min)Horarios: 6:30 AM - 3:30 PMEnviar Consulta Directa

gf-col-horarios-links.paragraph: 🕒 Desayunos: 6:30 - 11 AM🍴 Almuerzos: 11:30 - 3:30 PM🛡️ Garantía Térmica (75°C) & EmpaquesGastronomía Criolla PanameñaWhatsApp: +507 6234-5678

gf-footer-legal-copy.paragraph: © 2026 Eat & Go S.A. — Menú Digital Criollo Express. Todos los derechos reservados.

gf-footer-legal-terms.paragraph: R.U.C. 1557890-1-859472 DV 45 • Términos de Servicio • Aviso de Privacidad

style.menu-root-container: font-family: Open Sans, sans-serif; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 24px; max-width: 1200px; width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; padding: 40px 20px 60px 20px; box-sizing: border-box;
style.banner-resumen: background-color: #FCF9F2; border: 1px solid #F5E8C7; border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px 24px; display: flex; flex-direction: row; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 16px; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; @media(--mobile) { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }
style.banner-left: display: flex; flex-direction: row; align-items: center; gap: 14px;
style.banner-badge: background-color: #F59E0B; color: #18181B; font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap;
style.card-planificacion: background-color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E5E7EB; border-radius: 24px; padding: 32px 40px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 20px; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.03); @media(--mobile) { padding: 24px 20px; }
style.plan-eyebrow: color: #EA580C; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase;
style.plan-header-row: display: flex; flex-direction: row; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 24px; width: 100%; @media(--mobile) { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }
style.plan-header-left: display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; flex: 1;
style.plan-h1: font-size: 38px; font-weight: 800; color: #18181B; line-height: 1.15; margin: 0; @media(--mobile) { font-size: 28px; }
style.plan-header-box: background-color: #FFFBEB; border: 1px solid #FDE68A; border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px 20px; display: flex; flex-direction: row; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
style.selector-dias: display: flex; flex-direction: row; gap: 12px; align-items: center; overflow-x: auto; padding: 6px 0; margin: 12px 0; width: 100%;
style.dia-lunes: background-color: #F59E0B; color: #18181B; font-weight: 800; font-size: 14px; padding: 10px 22px; border-radius: 50px; border: 1px solid #F59E0B; cursor: pointer;
style.dia-martes: background-color: #FFFFFF; color: #4B5563; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; padding: 10px 22px; border-radius: 50px; border: 1px solid #E5E7EB; cursor: pointer;
style.dia-miercoles: background-color: #FFFFFF; color: #4B5563; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; padding: 10px 22px; border-radius: 50px; border: 1px solid #E5E7EB; cursor: pointer;
style.dia-jueves: background-color: #FFFFFF; color: #4B5563; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; padding: 10px 22px; border-radius: 50px; border: 1px solid #E5E7EB; cursor: pointer;
style.dia-viernes: background-color: #FFFFFF; color: #4B5563; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; padding: 10px 22px; border-radius: 50px; border: 1px solid #E5E7EB; cursor: pointer;
style.dia-sabado: background-color: #FFFFFF; color: #4B5563; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; padding: 10px 22px; border-radius: 50px; border: 1px solid #E5E7EB; cursor: pointer;
style.banner-dia-activo: background-color: #FEFCE8; border: 1px solid #FEF08A; border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px 24px; display: flex; flex-direction: row; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 12px; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; @media(--mobile) { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }
style.banner-dia-title-row: display: flex; flex-direction: row; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
style.dia-activo-badge: background-color: #FEF3C7; color: #92400E; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 8px;
style.dia-activo-counter: font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #71717A; background-color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E5E7EB; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 20px; white-space: nowrap;
style.grilla-platos: display: flex; flex-direction: row; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; @media(--mobile) { flex-direction: column; }
style.card-plato-1: background-color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E4E4E7; border-radius: 20px; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 0;
style.body-plato-1: padding: 18px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px;
style.side-plato-1: background-color: #F4F4F5; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 12px; color: #3F3F46; font-weight: 600; margin: 0;
style.footer-plato-1: display: flex; flex-direction: row; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-top: 6px;
style.btn-plato-1: background-color: #C81C20; color: #FFFFFF; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 50px; border: none; cursor: pointer;
style.card-plato-2: background-color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E4E4E7; border-radius: 20px; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 0;
style.body-plato-2: padding: 18px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px;
style.side-plato-2: background-color: #F4F4F5; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 12px; color: #3F3F46; font-weight: 600; margin: 0;
style.footer-plato-2: display: flex; flex-direction: row; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-top: 6px;
style.btn-plato-2: background-color: #C81C20; color: #FFFFFF; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 50px; border: none; cursor: pointer;
style.card-plato-3: background-color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E4E4E7; border-radius: 20px; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 0;
style.body-plato-3: padding: 18px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px;
style.side-plato-3: background-color: #F4F4F5; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 12px; color: #3F3F46; font-weight: 600; margin: 0;
style.footer-plato-3: display: flex; flex-direction: row; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-top: 6px;
style.btn-plato-3: background-color: #C81C20; color: #FFFFFF; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 50px; border: none; cursor: pointer;
style.gf-root-footer-wrapper: width: 100%; border-block-start-width: 1px; background-color: #F4F4F5; display: flex; justify-content: center; border-top-style: solid; border-top-color: #E4E4E7;
style.gf-footer-inner-boxed: width: 100%; max-width: 1320px; padding-block-start: 60px; padding-block-end: 24px; padding-inline-start: 24px; padding-inline-end: 24px; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
style.gf-footer-top-columns: width: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: row; gap: 32px; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start;
style.gf-col-branding: max-width: 320px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; flex: 1 1 280px; @media(--mobile) { max-width: 100%; }
style.gf-col-brand-header: display: flex; flex-direction: row; gap: 12px; align-items: center;
style.gf-col-brand-badge: font-family: "Open Sans"; font-weight: 800; font-size: 11px; color: #374151; letter-spacing: 0.8px; margin: 0px;
style.gf-col-brand-tagline: font-family: "Open Sans"; font-weight: 400; font-size: 11px; color: #6B7280; margin: 0px;
style.gf-col-brand-desc: font-family: "Open Sans"; font-size: 13px; color: #4B5563; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0px;
style.gf-col-brand-social-title: font-family: "Open Sans"; font-weight: 800; font-size: 11px; color: #18181B; letter-spacing: 0.8px; text-transform: uppercase; margin-block-start: 12px; margin-block-end: 0px;
style.gf-col-brand-social-row: display: flex; flex-direction: row; gap: 8px; align-items: center;
style.gf-col-nav: display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; flex: 1 1 180px;
style.gf-col-nav-title: font-family: "Open Sans"; font-weight: 800; font-size: 12px; color: #18181B; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0px;
style.gf-col-empresas: display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; flex: 1 1 180px;
style.gf-col-empresas-title: font-family: "Open Sans"; font-weight: 800; font-size: 12px; color: #18181B; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0px;
style.gf-col-ubicacion: display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; flex: 1 1 180px;
style.gf-col-ubicacion-title: font-family: "Open Sans"; font-weight: 800; font-size: 12px; color: #18181B; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0px;
style.gf-col-horarios: display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; flex: 1 1 180px;
style.gf-col-horarios-title: font-family: "Open Sans"; font-weight: 800; font-size: 12px; color: #18181B; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0px;
style.gf-footer-sublegal: width: 100%; padding-block-start: 24px; margin-block-start: 40px; border-block-start-width: 1px; display: flex; flex-direction: row; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; border-top-style: solid; border-top-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08); @media(--mobile) { text-align: center; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
